title: A morphism from an open subscheme into a proper scheme over the base extends to an open neighbourhood of a valuation-theoretic point in the closure
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that a morphism from an open subscheme into a proper scheme over the base extends over an open neighbourhood of a point lying in the closure of the open, provided the local ring at that point is a valuation ring and the source is reduced with finitely many components or Noetherian (statement lines 10424-10438). The counted proof has three distinct moves: it reduces the source to an affine integral one whose generic point realizes the fraction field of the valuation ring, applies the valuative criterion of properness to get a morphism on the spectrum of that local ring, spreads its germ to a neighbourhood, and glues it with the original morphism by comparing on the overlap through the equalizer, which is closed because the target is separated and contains the generic point (proof lines 10426-10473). It is H2: the argument is short but genuinely uses the valuative criterion and separatedness, and it is carried out entirely in the counted span.
